findings.title: governed definite land
findings.claim: The definite genitive land phrase makes the earth or land the bounded domain in which the wandering occurs.
findings.mechanism: The locative preposition fī governs the definite noun al-arḍi; their contact turns the verb's setting into a specified container rather than an unmarked backdrop.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the terrain as part of the punishment's grammatical architecture.
findings.containment: The ordinary 'wandering in the earth' remains intact; the finding adds the force of a governed, definite domain.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and its syntactic, lexical, or supplied local relation are directly supported by trusted packet evidence.

findings.title: holy goal becomes prison
findings.claim: The land named here carries the earlier commanded holy goal into the decree as a place of confinement.
findings.mechanism: The definite land phrase meets the supplied 5:21 echo while the holy qualifier is absent here; the same referent therefore returns in a reversed local role, as terrain in which wandering occurs.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the reversal from promised destination to enclosing ground.
findings.containment: This is a local echo-backed reversal of the land's role, not a claim that the land itself loses its prior status.

findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the consequence as a place-bound condition rather than an abstract distance.
findings.containment: The ordinary prohibition and wandering remain primary; the finding describes their local spatial contact.

findings.mechanism: The grief carrier meets the supplied treatment, relational-repair, collective, and shell-rupture branch records through the final command. The contact lets the ban on grief carry a bounded limit on therapeutic investment while the ordinary consolation remains intact.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the last command as regulating not only feeling but the direction of repair toward this ruptured group.
findings.containment: This is a qualified HFT nomination, not a medical or social prescription; the ordinary grief prohibition remains explicit and the repair color is bounded by the supplied branch roles.

epistemic.reason: The finding is supported by the supplied HFT trace and exact focus occurrences, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the packet marks the model as a nomination rather than an adjudicated result.
